scope.goal: Track npm and pnpm conformance for browser guest runtime productization.

cases.notes: Validates virtual store, workspace links, bin links, frozen lockfile invariants, and copy-fallback node_modules materialization from a native pnpm fixture.

cases.command: vendored CLI static require graph preflight
cases.notes: Walks vendored npm and pnpm entry module graphs, resolves simple computed path entries, handles JSON modules, ignores string/comment false positives, rejects missing package modules, and classifies remaining dynamic require plus unsupported builtin gaps without counting optional probes as product blockers.

cases.productGap: Browser runtime can validate and materialize local file dependency install layout with copy-fallback links. Full npm dependency graph execution still needs real CLI module evaluation.
Real npm ci still executes through host Node helper.

gate.reason: Version boot, local install layout, store plan, script/lifecycle/bin fixture, interrupted install-plan recovery, tarball cache paths, and static CLI graph classification pass or partially pass in browser guest runtime, but npm ci and full npm/pnpm CLI module evaluation still depend on host-node-test-helper. Static graph classification still exposes dynamic require and unsupported builtin gaps that must be closed before real CLI evaluation can become product-supported.
